description: Executable Candidate torch-distributed TP2 recipe for StepFun Step 3.7 Flash (198B sparse MoE vision-language model, about 11B active) as the official ModelOpt NVFP4 checkpoint on two Sparks, following MiaAI-Lab's Dual-DGX-Spark-Step-3.7-Flash-NVFP4 kit: the official vllm/vllm-openai:stepfun37 image pinned by digest (no Ray), step3p5 tool-call and reasoning parsers, FP8 KV cache, 256K context and eight sequences. MTP speculative decoding with three drafted tokens is upstream's default and is offered as a choice (off gives upstream's no-MTP baseline); the BF16 MTP layers now ship inside the pinned checkpoint, so upstream's download-time graft is not needed, and its drafter patch is applied at build time. Upstream reports about 31-32 tok/s with MTP 3 on two Sparks (a claim, not measured here). Code: MIT; model: Apache-2.0. Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Step 3.7 Flash NVFP4 vLLM two Sparks (Mia)
